chapter: Methods of Separation in Everyday Life
subject: Science
overview: Indha lesson-la mixtures-la irukkura components-ai separate panna handpicking, threshing, winnowing, sieving, sedimentation, decantation, filtration, evaporation matrum magnetic separation-ai eppadi use pannuvom-nu kathukkolvom. Method-ai mixture-oda properties base-la choose pannuvom.
learning_objectives: Handpicking, threshing, winnowing, sieving methods-ai identify panna mudiyum.
Sedimentation, decantation, filtration differences-ai compare panna mudiyum.
Evaporation use panni dissolved salt-ai recover panna mudiyum.
Magnetic separation eppadi work aagudhu-nu explain panna mudiyum.
Oru mixture-kku suitable separation sequence design panna mudiyum.

teaching_sequence.title: Mixtures yen separate pannanum?
teaching_sequence.caption: Daily life-la rice-la small stones, grains-la husk, tea-la leaves madhiri mixtures irukkum. Unwanted components remove panna alladhu useful parts collect panna separation methods use pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Malli-um Valli-um travel preparation-la food items sort pannura examples-ai imagine pannunga. Mixture-la irukkura parts size, weight, magnetic property base-la separate pannalaam.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Mixture-na enna? Rice-la irukkura small stones-ai eppadi remove pannuveenga?

teaching_sequence.title: Threshing, winnowing, handpicking
teaching_sequence.caption: Threshing-la harvested plants-lirundhu grains separate pannuvom. Winnowing-la wind use panni light husk-ai heavy grains-lirundhu separate pannuvom. Handpicking-la kaiyaal visible unwanted pieces remove pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Farmer bamboo tray-ai wind direction-la move pannumbodhu light husk far-aa pogum; heavier grains keezha vizhum. Idhu winnowing.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Threshing-um winnowing-um eppadi different? Winnowing-la weight-um wind-um eppadi help pannum?

teaching_sequence.title: Sieving matrum evaporation
teaching_sequence.caption: Sieving-la different particle sizes use pannuvom; small particles sieve holes vazhiya pass aagum, large particles mela stay aagum. Salt solution-ai evaporate panninaa water vapour aagi salt remain aagum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Flour sieve pannumbodhu fine flour pass aagum; bran/large particles retain aagum. Salt water-ai safe shallow dish-la sunlight-la evaporate panna salt crystals remain aagalam.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Sieving endha property base-la work aagudhu? Salt solution-la salt recover panna endha method use pannuvom?

teaching_sequence.title: Sedimentation matrum decantation
teaching_sequence.caption: Water-la insoluble heavy particles mix panninaa rest panna keezha settle aagum; idhu sedimentation. Mela irukkura clear liquid-ai careful-aa pour pannuradhu decantation. Rendu methods full separation guarantee pannaadhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Muddy water-ai konjam neram disturb pannaama vechaa sand keezha settle aagum. Appuram mela irukkura water-ai slow-aa vera vessel-la pour pannalaam.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Sedimentation-na enna? Decantation-la enna careful-aa seiyanum?

teaching_sequence.title: Filtration matrum straining
teaching_sequence.caption: Filter paper, cloth, sieve madhiri porous material use panni insoluble solids-ai liquid-lirundhu separate pannuvom. Tea strainer tea leaves-ai stop pannum; liquid tea pass aagum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Tea filter pannumbodhu leaves filter-la stay aagum; tea cup-kku pass aagum. Filter hole size, particle size separation-ai decide pannum.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Filtration-la residue-um filtrate-um enna? Tea strainer eppadi separate pannudhu?

teaching_sequence.title: Magnetic separation
teaching_sequence.caption: Mixture-la magnetic material irundhaa magnet use panni non-magnetic material-lirundhu separate pannalaam. Iron filings sand-oda mix aana magnet iron-ai attract pannum; sand attract aagadhu.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Magnet-ai paper/cover-la wrap panni iron filings pakkam kondu poi lift pannunga. Magnet-ai clean panna cover remove pannalaam; teacher supervision follow pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Magnetic separation-ku endha property use aagudhu? Iron filings-um sand-um eppadi separate pannuveenga?

teaching_sequence.title: Methods-ai choose pannuvom
teaching_sequence.caption: Mixture-oda particle size, weight, solubility, magnetic property base-la method choose pannuvom. Sila mixtures-ku one method podhaadhu; sequence-aa methods combine panna vendiyirukkum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Potato, salt, sawdust mixture-na handpicking-la potato remove pannalaam; water add panni salt dissolve pannalaam; sawdust float aagalaam, filter/decant pannalaam; salt water-ai evaporate pannalaam. Steps-ai reason-oda plan pannuvom.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Oru mixture-ku method choose panna enna properties check pannuveenga?

teaching_sequence.title: Separation recap matrum application
teaching_sequence.caption: Handpicking, threshing, winnowing, sieving, sedimentation, decantation, filtration, evaporation, magnetic separation — ovvoru method-um different property-ai use pannum. Correct method select panna separation efficient-aa nadakkum.
teaching_sequence.teacher_says: Kitchen, farm, water cleaning, recycling-la separation methods use aagudhu. Oru real-life mixture identify panni adhai separate panna step-by-step plan pannunga.
teaching_sequence.checkpoint: Oru daily-life mixture-ai choose panni, adhai separate panna suitable method-um reason-um sollunga.
